quarterly_data.signal: BizLink's investor deck (1Q 2026 version) gives Q1 2026 results: total sales NT$20.86B, gross margin 28.77%, operating margin 14.90%, net profit NT$2.27B, EPS NT$11.66. Sales mix chart: HPC was 45% of Q1 2026 sales (27% in 1Q25, 45% in 4Q25) and grew +125% YoY and +4% QoQ; SPE (capital equipment) was 13% (14% in 1Q25), +23% YoY and +19% QoQ; others 42% (59% in 1Q25), -6% YoY and -1% QoQ. By end market, IT DataComm was 46% of Q1 sales, Industrial 34%, Automotive 11% and Electrical Appliances 8%. The company says HPC and SPE remain the primary long-term growth drivers and that capital equipment demand is supported by ongoing system integration and outsourcing trends.
